signals.label: M7.7 furniture and fit PR #35
signals.scope: M7.7 was exact-head verified, product-owner accepted and squash-merged. It proves the searchable furniture catalogue, M2-derived fit explanations, selected-object inspector, atomic Apply and one-step semantic Undo described by that milestone. It does not prove final plan-recognition accuracy.

signals.label: M7.8A recognition benchmark PR #40
signals.scope: M7.8A established an eight-fixture public-safe benchmark, deterministic geometry/topology/opening/room/area/confidence metrics and real Chromium/OpenCV source execution. Product-owner calibration acceptance covered image-rectangle coordinates and undirected horizontal/vertical calibration. The accepted baseline intentionally exposed zero Source wall and opening F1 before quality tuning.

signals.label: M7.8B wall topology PR #41
signals.scope: Product-owner review failed on a representative clear apartment plan: the local Draft contained 417 wall candidates, zero openings and a symbol/furniture network instead of an architectural wall graph; AI reconciliation retained the polluted network and added unsupported long lines. Corrective structural masking reduced an isolated reproduction from about 948 to 115 unique segments and from 12,346 to 249 admissible parallel pairs, but current aggregate Source geometry/topology F1 is only approximately 0.492537/0.462687. PR #41 remains Draft and must not be described as accepted recognition quality.

signals.label: Installed 0.1.20 cumulative acceptance
signals.scope: Exact 0.1.20+1.21.1 installed acceptance ended as a partial PASS, not a full release acceptance. Text, STT, Chat, TTS, Voice Chat, Operator Lore scopes, restart, rollback-world loading and most synchronized gameplay scenarios passed. Release defects remained: an NPC became trapped in water and drowned; a filled grave broken with Silk Touch disappeared without an item; embedded identity reported a snapshot; and one Chat request took approximately 272 seconds.

signals.label: Corrective PRs #99–#102
signals.scope: PRs #99–#102 preserve vanilla water path positioning, retain filled-tombstone data, enforce exact embedded release identity and replace the production-unsafe tombstone Mixin with direct owned-source wiring. Exact-head repository, Fabric/NeoForge, remapped-package, security and applicable supply-chain gates passed. Installed acceptance remains pending for the exact 0.1.22+1.21.1 artifact.

signals.label: Installed 0.1.21 startup blocker and safe rollback
signals.scope: Exact 0.1.21+1.21.1 failed during startup before world and gameplay acceptance because MixinTombstoneBlock could not resolve the production getDrops target. The operator rolled back to 0.1.20; six persistent file hashes matched, the server reached STARTED, TCP 25565, UDP 24454, Voice Chat and monitoring recovered. This failure is not upgraded by the later automated correction.

Это доказательство относится только к foundation milestone.
